name: Mach7 trend pullback (EMA alignment + pullback + rebound trigger)
one_line: EMA fast>mid>slow trend; pulled back to fast EMA; enter on rebound bar above prior high; exit below EMA50.

source.license: no LICENSE file in repo; owner's own repository (owner-provided reference, do not redistribute)

markets: crypto, KR, US (individual symbols, owner-provided idea)
idea: Trend = EMA_fast > EMA_mid > EMA_slow. Pullback = low touched EMA_fast within last N bars. Trigger = close > EMA_fast and close > previous high. Stop = swing low of last N bars (only trade if below entry). Exit = close < EMA_exit. 3-bar cooldown.

rules.name: pullback_condition
rules.description: low <= EMA_fast within last pullback_window bars

rules.name: rebound_trigger
rules.description: close > EMA_fast and close > previous high

rationale: Buy dips inside confirmed trends; stop at structural low.
evidence: After bug fixes: coin average annualised -15.6% vs buy&hold -16.3% (alpha +0.7%); RSI-pullback variant -3.9% (alpha +12.4%); Bollinger variant -22.5%. Portfolio of 3 symbols 2018+: +62%/MDD 72%. Sweep: exit_ema=50 best, pullback_window=10 best.
limitations: rebuilt after two look-ahead bugs (see lessons entry)

pipeline_fit.notes: Several independent rules -> good ablation test case; EMA_alignment_filter may be redundant with the exit EMA.
